messages:
oncall-bot: Incident detected: multiple containers on runtime-gpu-pool-7 reporting CUDA OOM + container restart loop. Auto-alert created.
priya: seeing steady mem growth on /kvcache-attn allocator over last 12h, small allocation spikes then never reclaimed.
sre-james: logs show paged-attn allocator fragmentation + >80% resident after long-running chats. samples: `OOM when allocating 2.1 GiB; cuMemAlloc failed`
alex: stack trace (excerpt):
```
runtime: allocation failed: paged_allocator.cc:412
kv_cache: acquire_page_lock failed
cuda: cuMemAlloc returned 2 (out of memory)
```
maria: customers on Dedicated are seeing elevated 503s and increased latency. Customer Ops reporting 3 paid clusters affected.
priya: impact: ~4% of requests hitting fallback model; spikes correlate with long sequences. likely KV prefix growth without eviction.
platform-ben: quick mitigations: 1) reduce per-worker max_seq_len to 1024 for affected pool; 2) scale pool by +1 node; 3) enable aggressive kv_eviction for 30m. any objections?
sre-james: +1 for limits. also suggest immediate node drain / recreate for nodes in restart-loop to clear resident fragmentation.
alex: kubectl commands I'm running: `kubectl -n inference rollout pause ds/gpu-runtime && kubectl drain gpu-node-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
maria: Customer-ops: @customer-ops please prepare talking points: which customers, expected ETA to mitigation, mitigation steps.
customer-ops: preparing now. will message affected accounts and note temporary perf regression during restart window.
priya: additional data: heap snapshot attached to alert shows many stale KV slots: ~18% unreachable but pinned in allocator bitmap. probably slow leak from session mismatch on reconnect.
sre-james: mitigation patch idea: compact-on-evict loop to defragment paged allocator (low-risk toggle). can we hotflip a feature flag?
platform-ben: yes, `runtime.cfg.compact_on_evict=true` can be toggled via console; rolling to pool should be sticky. but needs monitoring for perf regressions.
alex: rolling flag to pool now for gpu-pool-7. command: `redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool gpu-pool-7 --key compact_on_evict --value true`
oncall-bot: (automated) config-change: compact_on_evict=true applied to gpu-pool-7 by alex at 2026-03-17T18:07:12Z
sre-james: watch logs for fragmentation counters: `kvcache.fragments` and `allocator.free_runs`. if fragments drop and free_runs increase, good sign.
priya: also bump eviction aggressiveness: `kv.eviction_threshold=0.65` for 20m window. doing that now.
platform-ben: spun up extra node, but node creation lag ~3m. keep scaling until residual mem normalizes.
maria: customers notified: expected 10-15m for restarts and config rollout. asking for pause on big-batch jobs.
customer-ops: one customer asked for SLA credit escalation path; capturing details.
sre-james: observed one node still OOMing on restart — probe shows nvml reports page-allocator fragmentation > 90% and cuda mem not reclaiming across container restart. need full node reprovision and kernel driver reload.
alex: initiating reprovision: `gcloud compute instances reset gpu-node-27` then `kubectl delete pod -l node=gpu-node-27`
priya: FYI, found correlation with long-lived chat sessions using function-calls + large system prompts; suggest a short-term router rule to strip extremely long prompts > 8k tokens for affected pool.
platform-ben: adding rule: `route-policy: if seq_len>8000 -> route: fallback-small` for gpu-pool-7 for 30m. applied.
maria: good. monitor customer impact, be ready to rollback if too aggressive.
sre-james: post-mitigation checklist: 1) confirm fragmentation counters return to normal; 2) ensure no further OOM restarts in 30m; 3) collect heap dumps for root cause; 4) create postmortem with timeline and fix plan.
priya: capturing heap dumps now, uploading to /sre-artifacts/incidents/6580004321/heap-dumps.tar.gz
customer-ops: affected list: acct-237 (prod), acct-910 (staging), acct-811 (prod). notified with ETA.
alex: node reprovision complete, pods rescheduled. memory marks trending down. one container still hit a `cuCtxSynchronize: device-side assert` earlier but cleared after restart.
sre-james: good. keep compact_on_evict enabled for the next 48h while we evaluate. schedule a canary rollback plan in 6h.
platform-ben: opening a temporary alert mute for noisy OOM alerts on pool-7 while we monitor.
maria: customer-ops please confirm customers see recovery; update thread when all three report normal.
customer-ops: acct-237 reports improved latency; acct-811 still seeing intermittent 503s but they're reduced by ~70%.
priya: log metrics look healthy: kvcache.fragments down from 42% -> 8% over last 12m. eviction rate increased.
sre-james: marking incident as mitigated for now. leaving running actions: compact flag ON, eviction threshold lowered, scale +1 node. follow-ups: bug to fix stale pinning on reconnect, add allocator defensive compaction in runtime, add perf test for long-sequence function-calls.
maria: thanks all. oncall-handoff in 1h to night team. :thumbsup:
platform-ben: creating follow-up ticket INF-5429 for root cause + tests.
priya: adding reproduction steps and heap dump links to ticket.
alex: if anything flares up ping me, I'll be standby.
oncall-bot: Incident mitigated -> status: recovered. duration: ~43m. severity: SEV2.
